Remark
[Riemannian volume expansion (A. Gray)]

Source: petersen:page-0246 ↗ rem:pet-ch5-ex-42 1. ch5:5.9.43With notation as in section 8: (1) show $\sqrt{\det (g_{ij})}=1-\tfrac 16\mathrm{Ric}_{ij}x^ix^j+O(|x|^3)$; (2) (A. Gray) show $\operatorname {vol}B(p,r)=\omega _nr^n\big(1-\tfrac {\mathrm{scal}(p)}{6(n+2)}r^2 +O(r^3)\big)$, $\omega _n=\operatorname {vol}(B(0,1)\subset \mathbb R^n)$, by expanding the volume integral in polar coordinates using (1).
